allocation.comparative_reasoning: Alternatives considered: (a) PARK, as the dated program audit recommends absent a materially new observable/dataset - this is the strongest counter-argument and I take it seriously; however the barrier observable is new in kind (access/rate dynamics rather than content dynamics), it is not in the audit's list of exhausted estimators, and the lane is otherwise idle; (b) continue value/dynamics estimator work on the existing HTTP signatures - rejected because the last audited packet closed that sub-question and further refinement is exactly the low-marginal-value loop the audit warns about; (c) wait for new BrowserGym/production banks - correct in principle but no such dataset provisioned this cycle, so it would leave the lane idle indefinitely. REOPEN with a hard attainability/power gate dominates: it dies cheaply and honestly if the certificate fails, and otherwise opens a new sub-question.
allocation.question: On credential-free public HTTP GET substrates (the frozen 57-endpoint universe plus any preregistered extension), are the ONSET and RECOVERY of server-side ACCESS BARRIERS - Cloudflare-style 403 challenge pages, 429 rate limits, and connection-level transport failures - predictable from observable request-history features (request rate, burstiness, inter-request spacing, per-session cookie-jar continuity/freshness, endpoint identity) BEYOND a frozen memory/constant null calibrated before freeze with demonstrated power, and separable from ordinary endpoint-level unavailability (403-as-block versus 403-as-legitimate-response, and 404/500 as non-barrier failures), such that an agent can hold target success rate near the no-barrier baseline while issuing measurably fewer requests than unconditional retry? A REQUIRED no-adaptation/unconditional-retry baseline must be expressed relative to the adaptive policy; the falsifier must be satisfiable in BOTH directions; and a pre-freeze, arithmetically checkable attainability/power certificate must prove barrier events are reachable in the frozen pool with demonstrated power BEFORE freeze. The prior packet's incidental 120 HTTP 403s, 65 429s and 24 transport errors are NOT an attainability certificate.
allocation.rationale: Physics is idle after a clean, audited negative (EXP-PHYSICS-37973239386) that rejected the value-level persistence subhypothesis on the credential-free action-gating substrate and left C-WEB-DYNAMICS at HYPOTHESIS. Access-barrier onset/recovery is a genuinely different observable from the content-transformation dynamics the lane mined for the last 8 of 10 experiments, it has direct product leverage (scheduling re-observation to hold success rate while issuing fewer requests), and the parent handoff already internalized the program's known failure mode by demanding an attainability certificate. Reactivating an idle lane on a new, falsifiable, product-relevant observable is preferable to leaving it accidentally dormant; PARK would forgo useful work with no compensating benefit.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: Cycle 37988756989. 429 canonical experiments; 3 lanes carry frozen transactions that must be completed under their frozen design (frontier: C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY site-native discovery vs link-following BFS; intel: C-LLM-INHERIT credential-free model provisioning / re-scope; runtime: C-MEAS-VALID outside-surface intervention-oracle discrimination plus the within-50ms write-revert blind-spot probe), and 3 are idle (graph, physics, product). This window cleared two central prerequisites: product established that the shipped kernel's parameterize->resolve->execute path is live, causally attributable and honestly accounted on a real credential-free substrate (EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064), and graph advanced C-FRESHNESS HYPOTHESIS->EXPERIMENTAL after confirming an extraction defect and session-scoped value rotation on four pinned anchors (EXP-GRAPH-37978902447). The central missing proof is still the integrated causal chain (observation -> parameterized mechanism -> executable binding in the shipped kernel -> applicability/freshness decision -> real external agent action -> lower cost per successful task). The sharpest observed bottleneck is that the credential-free task bank has no dynamic range: both C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY (EXP-PRODUCT-37982016598) and the earlier C-PARAM-INHERIT margin failed because cold re-derivation and the retrieval-shaped comparator sit at the correctness ceiling, so any economics comparison is degenerate before it starts. Product must therefore build a task bank whose correct action is NOT determined by the task specification and certify dynamic range arithmetically BEFORE freeze. For graph, the freshness/applicability guard is the decision-bearing piece of that chain: the last packet left PART II (the incumbent value-blind false-accept differential) degenerate because all D1V trials came from a single anchor, so a multi-anchor D1V population is required to decide whether a value-aware channel is needed in the product freshness guard. Physics produced a clean, audited negative on value-level action-gating predictability (EXP-PHYSICS-37973239386) and is off the critical path; the one materially new observable it can still test without a new dataset is access-barrier onset/recovery dynamics, which carries product leverage (request scheduling) but also the program's documented attainability failure mode, so I reopen it only under a mandatory pre-freeze attainability/power certificate. Expected marginal value is concentrated on (1) the policy/task-bank dynamic-range prerequisite in Product and (2) the multi-anchor freshness-guard discrimination in Graph; the already-frozen transactions are preserved unchanged.
